quest.beyondsolo.isle.king.desc: The queen's death woke something worse. %s has hatched in the hive, and he is hungry. Kill him before he grows any stronger.
worldboss.beyondsolo.queen.title: Mother of the Hive
worldboss.beyondsolo.king.title: the Hive King
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.hive_qu: The swollen queen in the deep of Halcyon Isle. Every creature of the swarm crawled out of her, and while she lives the nests above keep breeding. Hurt her and her royal guard comes running.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.hive_ki: The swarm's last child, who breaks out of the cocoon at his mother's side the moment she dies. Lean, winged and terribly fast, he grows stronger with every hunter he devours. His shadow is a commander's, for a necromancer able to call it.
title.beyondsolo.hive_breaker.desc: Land with a raid that retakes Halcyon Isle.
title.beyondsolo.kingslayer.desc: Do the most to the Hive King as he falls.
title.beyondsolo.nestburner.desc: Be there when 12 nests burn on Halcyon Isle.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.call: Has the Association call a raid now: everyone it would call, or just the players named.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.land: Lands the players on the island at once, calling a raid for them if none is on.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.launch: Ends the muster now: whoever answered lands.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.phase: Skips the raid ahead to that phase (nests burned, queen awake, king born).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.end: Wins the raid (everyone is paid), loses it, or stops it with nothing paid.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.status: How the raid stands, with the operator's details.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.next: Sets the next call to that many minutes from now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.build: Builds the island again from nothing.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.visit: Takes the player to the island's camp to look around (/isle leave goes back).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.record: Shows a player's record of the raids.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.isle.reset: Clears the players' records of the raids.
command.beyondsolo.solo.isle.stopped: The raid is stopped, and nobody was paid.

command.beyondsolo.solo.isle.visit: %s is on Halcyon Isle. /isle leave takes them back.
